selection: All 22 active original six-stock GARCH long-flat trades, 60-minute entry cost hurdle, zero-bid writedown scenario; no re-selection at other hedge frequencies
entries_exits: One long call plus one long put. Freeze original entries and actual exits, retain original capital reserve, flag any changed exit. Long positions have no short exercise-risk trigger.
signals: Strictly past market-implied American Delta, evaluated separately at t-15m and t-1m; current and signal stock quotes must pass filters. Whole shares, displayed size limits.
sessions: NYSE regular sessions only; overnight jumps retained. No interpolation or simulated sub-minute prices.
cost_definition: Historical bid/ask plus original assumed fees/slippage versus midpoint executable orders with no execution costs. Both retain financing, stock borrow, idle-cash benchmark, and zero recovery for unbid abandoned long rights.
scope: Conditional comparison of all original selected long trades, not a new blind holdout, new model fit, portfolio backtest, or re-optimized entry threshold.
purchase_policy: Use existing authenticated Theta entitlement; no purchases or subscription changes
